newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kone repeats sees only slight 97 upturn.
newsitem.headline: Kone repeats sees only slight 97 upturn.

text.p: Finnish elevator maker Kone Oy repeated on Thursday that it expects only a slight improvement in 1997 earnings and its post-tax 1996 result will be close to zero.

"Kone's after-tax income for 1996 will not reach the previous year's level and is expected to be about zero. The result for 1997 will only be slightly better," Kone said in a statement with its January-August results.
For full year 1995, Kone reported net income of 67 million markka and profit after financial items of 202 million markka.
The company warned on September 19 it expected near-zero earnings for 1996 due to problems in its Italian operations where losses would approach 200 million markka for 1996.

"Correcting these problems is proving more costly and time-consuming than was originally anticipated," Kone said in Thursday's statement. "Measures currently being implemented are expected to return Kone's Italian operations to profitability during 1997."
